issues.description: Method parameter label mismatch for Course.addRating: the problem statement and the template require an instance method with the external parameter label 'stars' (addRating(stars: Int)) but the solution implements the method with the external label 'rating' (func addRating(rating: Int)). The solution's Client code still calls addRating(stars: ...), so the implemented signature (solution Repository Course.swift line 25) does not match the call sites (solution Repository Client.swift lines 14-15) nor the template/spec (problem_statement.md line 15 and template Course.swift line 24). This inconsistency will cause a compilation error and will confuse students following the exercise instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter label consistent across all artifacts. Prefer changing the solution's Course implementation to use the external parameter name 'stars' so the signature matches the problem statement and the existing client calls: update `func addRating(rating: Int)` to `func addRating(stars: Int)` and rename internal references accordingly. Alternatively, update all client call sites and the problem/template to use `rating:`, but aligning the solution to the spec (`stars`) preserves the exercise intent.
